title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists the atmosphere's mass as 5.1 × 10^18 kg
summary: The same fact sheet lists the total mass of the atmosphere as 5.1 × 10^18 kilograms.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists the total mass of the atmosphere as 5.1 × 10^18 kilograms. The sheet also lists a surface pressure of 1014 millibars and a mean molecular weight of 28.97, which are already on the dry-air card. This card is only the mass line.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
